comparison.objective: Open a folding-table leg, lock its brace ring, and withstand a side load, versus set and jam-lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1663 swings a linkage and slides a discrete ring over a knee; the candidate continuously adjusts a screw and counterholds it while tightening a concentric nut.
comparison.success_condition: Both include hands-clear functional retention, but PR-1663 checks an open leg and brace under side load while the candidate checks retained opening angle across cycles.
comparison.reason: The shared lock-and-test pattern is generic; sliding a brace sleeve on an articulated linkage does not test preserving a screw setting against tightening reaction.
